name: account.avatar_upload
description: A new file for the caller's own profile picture: a JPEG, PNG or WebP of at most 5 MB. Records the core's key as the caller's, and answers a signed write URL and the file's stable address, which account.avatar_set then takes. A person only, not an agent.
sql:
with made as (insert into brandbase.avatar_uploads (key, user_id) values (:file, brandbase.caller()) returning key)
select jsonb_build_object('upload', jsonb_build_object('key', made.key, 'type', :mime::text)) as result from made
